liveAudit.spaNavigation: Launch through the panel with launchTool(), then navigate INSIDE the booted SPA by assigning location.href to the origin plus hash route, then wait 20-22s. Never run `opencli browser <session> open` against a hash deep link: that full-document-loads the route and yields the blank shell. This is exactly what gotoInTool() in backlink/scripts/lib-tools-share.mjs already does, so the working scripts were never blocked - only ad-hoc open calls were.
liveAudit.stuckPageGuidance: Retry the CLICK, not the page. Reload storms transiently destroy the left navigation, which made 11 pages falsely report 'nav item not found'; a 6x click-retry with 6s waits recovered all 11. Also, short innerText is not a stuck signal on this SPA - several pages render complete correct data in under 600 characters because the charts are SVG.

similarweb.interfaceVerdict: A shared-account proxy lends a session, not an account. Every interface that needs an account-level API key or OAuth consent is unreachable here, so browser capture is the correct method rather than a fallback.
ifSelfSubscribed: Call the three free discovery endpoints first: /v3/batch/credits, /v3/batch/user-credits, /v3/batch/tables/describe. They consume no quota and tables/describe enumerates every virtual table, metric, and granularity.
Batch API exposes daily granularity, which the panel never shows.
